page_title: INT 2-1 FIO | Inter v Fiorentina 10/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea easily deals with the threat.
90+1' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The ball possession at the moment is 63:37.
88' Carlos Augusto (Inter) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise David de Gea and he's equal to it.
85' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
85' Fiorentina win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
80' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) replacing Rolando Mandragora.
79' Nicolo Barella (Inter) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
79' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
79' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Inter get a corner.
78' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
77' It's time for a substitution. Mehdi Taremi (Inter) comes on in place of Marko Arnautovic.
75' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
73' The attendance for today's match is 67484.
70' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
70' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
70' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' Here comes a substitution. Matias Moreno is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina).
66' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
66' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
66' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) replaces Lucas Beltran.
65' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Alessandro Bastoni and he is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (Inter).
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Henrikh Mkhitaryan walks off the pitch to be replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
63' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
63' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
63' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
62' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Fabiano Parisi is replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina).
62' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amir Richardson.
60' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:2.
58' Marko Arnautovic latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Nicolo Barella (Inter) and heads towards goal.
57' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
56' Inter have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
52' 2 - 1 Carlos Augusto launches a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Marko Arnautovic (Inter) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. 2:1.
50' The game is interrupted. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Simone Inzaghi gives a chance to Piotr Zielinski (Inter) and Hakan Calhanoglu is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' It's like he was asking for a caution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
45+2' Federico La Penna rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Yann Sommer no chance!
44' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
43' It’s a PENALTY to Fiorentina after the VAR review!
42' Referee Federico La Penna makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fiorentina. Let’s see what happens!
41' Matteo Darmian (Inter) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
41' Fiorentina earn a corner.
39' Inter are awarded a mid-range free kick.
39' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
33' A clumsy foul by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) and Federico La Penna blows his whistle.
32' Raffaele Palladino appears to have said too much and referee Federico La Penna comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
32' Referee Federico La Penna halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Simone Inzaghi, then shows him a yellow.
31' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) gets inside the box and tries to beat David de Gea with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
28' 1 - 0 Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner inside the left post of his own net.
28' There's an opportunity for Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
28' Simone Inzaghi is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Marcus Thuram (Inter) suffers an injury and Marko Arnautovic comes on.
24' CHANCE! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
23' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take a corner kick.
23' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

21' Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
19' Nicolo Barella (Inter) prepares to take a corner kick.
17' No change in the score after an effort on goal by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) from a rebound. Good save by the goalkeeper.
15' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) and Moise Kean perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
12' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' A crossfield pass from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

8' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but David de Gea was ready and made a save.
5' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips in a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is well positioned and punches the ball away.
4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Matteo Darmian (Inter) heads on.
2' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Federico La Penna got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
